title: Worst far line equals the worst PERIOD not the worst frequency (line-incidence spectral collapse + coset-period count)
wall: W-BGK / W-Paley: after the (genuine, in-tree) period collapse the worst far line equals B = max_{b!=0}||eta_b|| = the worst Gauss period = the non-principal generalized-Paley eigenvalue. The m distinct periods ARE the distinct nonzero-frequency values of eta, so 'period not frequency' is a relabeling of the same 25-year-open object, not a smaller target.
evidence: Exact/high-precision probe scripts/probes/_407_conn/C064_period_vs_frequency.py at FOUR proper dyadic subgroups mu_n < F_q* in the prize regime (n=8 q=521 beta=3.01; n=16 q=4129 beta=3.00; n=32 q=8353 beta=2.61; n=64 q=32833 beta=2.50; n<<sqrt(q)). (P1, baseline = the in-tree eta_image_card_mul_le content) eta_b takes EXACTLY m=(q-1)/n distinct values at every config (65/258/261/513 = m exactly), and every value's preimage is a union of mu_n cosets with multiplicity EXACTLY n (verified to 4 d.p.; the 6 d.p. 'mult multiple of n=True' / var mismatch at n>=16 in the first run was a float-dedup artifact, corrected to exact-n by the higher-precision recheck). This confirms the Gauss-period collapse numerically. (P2, THE LOAD-BEARING CLAIM) The connection's 'monomial far direction' reduction makes the per-far-line spectral contribution Sum_{s in S} psi(s0-s) factor through eta_b. Then worst-far-line-error = worst-period = worst-(q)frequency-restricted-to-mu_n = B at EVERY config (6.5624/11.1403/16.8914/32.5508, all three quantities equal to 1e-6). The 'period not frequency' distinction is therefore VACUOUS: the m periods ARE the distinct nonzero-frequency values of eta (the q-1 frequencies collapse onto m values BY coset-invariance), and the worst case is the SAME number B either way -- no new tractable object is produced. (P3, F18 variance) Because eta is CONSTANT on each coset, the 'n-weighted average of m periods' returns each coset's own value, so the per-frequency variance equals the per-period variance EXACTLY (var_freq==var_period; the n-weighting is rigorously trivial). And the variance does NOT pin B: the extreme-value heuristic mean+sqrt(2*var*ln m) (36.5/86.7/174.8/427.2) systematically UNDERSHOOTS B^2 (43.1/124.1/285.3/1059.6) -- F18 flatness is blind to the worst-case magnitude, exactly the refuted C045/C060 lesson.
honest_note: The connection's IDENTITY content is real and already proven in-tree axiom-clean: lineIncidence_spectral (LineIncidenceSpectral.lean) collapses the incidence onto the s1^perp hyperplane, and eta_image_card_mul_le (GaussPeriodCosetReduction.lean) proves eta takes <=(q-1)/n distinct values with each fiber a full G-coset. P1 confirms both numerically. That fused triple identity (F3 count = F2 char-sum = F7 period-spectrum, with the multiplicity-n quantization) is a correct and pretty observation. What does NOT survive is the OPERATIVE strengthening -- that this makes the worst far line a 'worst PERIOD not worst frequency' in any sense that yields a smaller/cleaner open object. Once you take the connection's own monomial reduction, the per-far-line error factors through eta_b, so the worst far line is exactly B = max_b ||eta_b|| = the worst Gauss period, and the m periods are simply the distinct nonzero values of eta (cosets collapse q-1 frequencies to m). 'Period not frequency' is then a relabeling, not a reduction: it is the SAME number, the SAME 25-year-open BGK/Paley-graph non-principal eigenvalue (face 3 of the open core). The F18-variance claim is worse: the n-weighting is provably trivial (eta constant on cosets => var unchanged) and variance does not determine the extreme B (C045/C060). So the connection welds straight back to W-BGK with no progress beyond restating it. Not a closure, not a refutation of a false statement (the identity is TRUE), not a sharpening (it relabels the same B). Labeled OPEN per the contract: 'welds back to BGK/Paley'. Probes are exact-integer for the moments and primitive roots, high-precision complex for the spectra at small n; not a Lean lemma (the identity pieces are already Lean-proven and were read, not re-derived). Suggest a one-line DISPROOF_LOG note: 'C064 -- line-incidence period collapse is a true identity but worst-far-line = worst-period = B = BGK eigenvalue; n-weighting trivial (eta coset-constant), variance blind to B; relabeling not reduction.'
